title: Happy zebra
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="26" ry="17" fill="#e8e8f0"/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="30" y="72" width="7" height="18" rx="3" fill="#e8e8f0"/>
  <rect x="42" y="74" width="7" height="16" rx="3" fill="#c9c9dd"/>
  <rect x="56" y="74" width="7" height="16" rx="3" fill="#e8e8f0"/>
  <rect x="66" y="72" width="7" height="18" rx="3" fill="#c9c9dd"/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x="30" y="87" width="7" height="5" rx="2" fill="#6a5acd"/>
  <rect x="42" y="87" width="7" height="4" rx="2" fill="#6a5acd"/>
  <rect x="56" y="87" width="7" height="4" rx="2" fill="#6a5acd"/>
  <rect x="66" y="87" width="7" height="5" rx="2" fill="#6a5acd"/>
  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d="M38 48 q3 14 -1 26" stroke="#4b4b78" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 47 q1 15 0 28" stroke="#4b4b78" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M62 48 q-2 14 1 26" stroke="#4b4b78" stroke-width="4" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d="M68 50 L82 30 L88 26 L86 40 L74 58 Z" fill="#e8e8f0"/>
  <!-- neck stripes -->
  <path d="M72 48 L84 36" stroke="#4b4b78" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M76 52 L87 40" stroke="#4b4b78" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="84" cy="26" rx="11" ry="9" fill="#e8e8f0"/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx="92" cy="30" rx="6" ry="5" fill="#f3c6d0"/>
  <!-- nostril -->
  <circle cx="95" cy="30" r="1.4" fill="#8a4b5c"/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <path d="M77 18 L74 10 L82 15 Z" fill="#e8e8f0"/>
  <path d="M77 17 L76 12 L80 15 Z" fill="#f3c6d0"/>
  <path d="M88 17 L91 9 L93 16 Z" fill="#e8e8f0"/>
  <path d="M89 16 L91 11 L92 15 Z" fill="#f3c6d0"/>
  <!-- mane -->
  <path d="M78 17 q-2 -6 2 -8 q1 5 3 4 q-1 -7 3 -8 q0 6 2 6 q0 -6 3 -6 q0 7 2 7" fill="#6a5acd"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="82" cy="24" r="2.4" fill="#2f2f52"/>
  <circle cx="83" cy="23" r="0.9" fill="#cfd0ff"/>
  <circle cx="89" cy="23" r="2" fill="#2f2f52"/>
  <circle cx="89.6" cy="22.3" r="0.8" fill="#cfd0ff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M87 33 q4 3 7 0" stroke="#8a4b5c" stroke-width="1.6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- tail -->
  <path d="M25 56 q-7 2 -8 10" stroke="#4b4b78" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M17 66 q-3 4 0 7 q3 -3 1 -7" fill="#6a5acd"/>
</svg>
